Regular City Council Meeting
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL
1245 North Hacienda Road
La Habra Heights, California
6:00 p.m. Interview for the Wildlife Corridor Conservation Authority Advisory Committee
6:30 p.m. Closed Session
07:30 p.m. Regular Business
December 11, 2008
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
The City Council will listen to the public on any numbered item on the agenda or any item that is not on the agenda but relevant to City business. The City Council cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future agenda. If you wish to speak to the Council, please complete a Speaker's Card and present it before the agenda item is called. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak to the Council. Should you need to provide written documentation to the City, please give the City Manager a minimum of seven (7) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed appropriately. Comments will generally be limited to three minutes per speaker. However, a shorter limit may be declared by the Mayor for agenda items for which many Speaker Cards have been submitted.
Public Comment For Items On The Agenda: Speakers will be called on in the order cards were received.
Public Comment For Items Not On The Agenda: Persons wishing to speak on agenda items will be called at the time the agenda item is brought forward.
CLOSED SESSION
1.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL The City Council/Agency finds, based on advice from legal counsel, that discussion in open session will prejudice the position of the local agency in the litigation.
a.
Existing Litigation:
G.C.
54956.9(a)
Name of Case: Somma v. City of La Habra Heights, LASC #BC402306
2.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL
b.
Anticipated Litigation:
G.C.
54956.9(b)
A point has been reached where, in the opinion of the City Council/Agency on the advice of its legal counsel, based on the below-described existing facts and circumstances, there is a significant exposure to litigation against the City Council/Agency.
Statement made by Christy O'Donnell outside an open meeting of City regarding potential claims by John Nielsen regarding his employment and workers compensation and a record of the statement was made by the City Attorney prior to the meeting and is available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office.

A.
Accept the bid of $31,000 from Burch Ford and authorize the purchase of a Ford Escape hybrid from account 05-20-00-9089.
B.
Declare the Taurus as surplus and authorize disposal per Municipal Code.
- or -
C.
Instruct the City Manager to prepare a bid package and advertise for bids for the following vehicle _______________________________.
Item 17 - Hybrid Vehicle
AGENDA MODIFICATION
18.
REOPEN DISCUSSION ON THE $100,000 KNABE GRANT - REQUEST FROM PARKS MASTER PLAN COMMITTEE TO FORWARD DESIGN FOR MULTI-USE TRAIL IN THE PARK TO THE PARKS MASTER PLAN AND PARKS AND RECREATION COMMITTEES FOR OVERVIEW PRIOR TO COMPLETION.
RECOMMENDATION: Refer the design for the trails grant (Knabe) to the Parks and Recreation and Parks Master Plan Committee with the understanding that their input must be complete and on file with the city by _____________________ - or -
Direct staff to proceed no further with the grant proposal.
CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS
ADJOURNMENT - Mayor Stan Carroll adjourned the City Council meeting at 10:18 p.m.
UPON ADJOURNMENT OF THE MEETING, WE ASK EVERYONE TO PLEASE LEAVE THE ROOM PROMPTLY AND REMOVE ANY PERSONAL BELONGINGS, SO THAT STAFF MAY CLEAR AND CLOSE THE ROOM. IF YOU ARE RECORDING, PLEASE BE AWARE THAT THE CONVERSATIONS THAT TAKE PLACE ONCE THE ROOM IS CLOSED ARE NOT PART OF THE PUBLIC MEETING, MAY BE PRIVATE AND THEREFORE MAY REQUIRE THE CONSENT OF ALL PARTIES TO THE CONVERSATION BEFORE RECORDING.
